lines.t: You watch me while I'm sleeping,
You knew me before my first breath.
You held me before the world was turning,
You loved me before my first step.
You comfort me when I am weeping,
Correct me with a loving hand.
Even when You speak in judgment,
It's love that leads You every time.
Every road You lead me through,
Every tear that falls, You knew.
Every heartbeat whispers truth...
What could this be but love?
Love that never lets me go.
Love that found me in the darkness,
Love that calls my spirit home.
What could this be but love?
Stronger than the fear I've known.
You gave everything to save me—
This is love... this is love.
You wore the weight that should have crushed me,
Carried every hidden shame.
Even while You hung in suffering,
You still remembered my name.
Your mercy reaches through the silence,
Your kindness breaks the hardest stone.
Every scar tells one unending story:
I have never been alone.
Every promise still remains,
Faithful through my doubt and pain.
You are always just the same.
What could this be but love?
Love that never lets me go.
Love that found me in the darkness,
Love that calls my spirit home.
What could this be but love?
Stronger than the fear I've known.
You gave everything to save me—
This is love... this is love.
No power, no shadow,
No mountain, no sea,
Nothing could keep
Your heart from reaching me.
Forever I'm Yours,
Forever You're near.
Your perfect love
Is louder than my fear.
Oh... Your love remains.
Oh... Your love remains.
What could this be but love?
Love that conquered death alone.
Love that left the grave behind
So I'd never walk alone.
What could this be but love?
Every breath belongs to You.
King of mercy, King of glory,
All I am belongs to You.
You watch me while I'm sleeping...
You knew me before the world began.
What could this be but love?
